five_fold_calibration.method: seed2027 SHA256 decoded-pixel groups, five disjoint approximate domain-stratified folds; checkpoint had already used all validation for selection, so this isolates calibration optimism only

domain_calibration_transfer.limitation: Existing model was trained on every dataset; this is threshold transfer, NOT leave-one-domain-out model evaluation.

loss_threshold_analysis.interpretation: For an ideal weighted-BCE optimum under the sampled training distribution only; not a calibrated posterior guarantee or causal ablation.
